meta.title: SeoulFit Itinerary Agent — Request to Itinerary

views.label: Slot intake
views.note: Gemini JSON-mode slot extraction repeats until the user confirms the trip summary.

views.label: Segmented retrieval
views.note: Per-area FAISS anchors, then Google Places fills the gaps curated courses leave open.

views.label: Plan and repair
views.note: Gemini drafts the itinerary; the critic scores it and the repairer patches it before it ships.

messages.label: POST /chat {thread_id, message}
messages.note: A NeMo self-check input rail screens the message first and fails open on any error.

messages.label: extract slots + intent — one JSON retry
per-segment search, top-k anchors back
messages.note: parse_day_segments splits a multi-area trip first; rerank_courses_by_area then demotes off-neighborhood courses.

messages.label: gap fill: cafe, food, K-POP, shopping
itinerary JSON, then validate and repair
messages.note: Fence and comma repair, FixJSON fallback, then a deterministic pass against the candidate pool.

messages.label: score, patch, re-score
messages.note: Coverage and feasibility weigh 0.35 each; duplicates and foreigner friction 0.15 each.
